title: a2kit ADR frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block of every docs/adr/NNNN-*.md file. The frontmatter is the agent-grep layer: structured metadata an LLM can read without loading the body. The body itself is unconstrained prose per docs/adr/README.md.

id.description: Four-digit zero-padded ADR id. Must match the NNNN prefix on the filename.

status.description: Lifecycle state. proposed = open for debate. accepted = load-bearing decision. deprecated = no longer recommended but not replaced. superseded = replaced by a later ADR (set superseded_by).

date.description: Original acceptance date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Never changes after acceptance.

last_reviewed.description: Most recent re-validation date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Bumped when the ADR is reaffirmed in a periodic review. Drives the staleness CI gate.

supersedes.description: List of ADR ids this one replaces. Empty list if none.

superseded_by.description: Id of the ADR that replaced this one. null if not superseded. When non-null, status must be 'superseded'.

tags.description: Free-text tags for filtering. Lowercase kebab-case. Examples: cli, surface, authoring, dispatcher, lifecycle, packaging, architecture, infrastructure.

deciders.description: Humans who signed off on the decision. Free-text names; useful for accountability and routing future questions.
